content:
noah: follow-up from yesterday's RFC about splitting "verify" work out of intake. idea: intake remains the fast admit path (fingerprint + tiny smoke), and a separate verify-worker does reproducible microbench + quality checks async. want quick alignment on interfaces and blocking semantics.

priya: big +1. intake should only block on deterministic failures (signature mismatch, corrupt artifacts, basic smoke failing). everything else gets a provisional admit with status=quarantine until verify-worker finishes.

akiko: two immediate questions: 1) how do we represent provisional vs final state in registry? 2) what happens if verify-worker later flags a severe regression? auto-revoke? manual triage?

noah: registry idea: model.entry.state = admitted|provisional|quarantined|rejected. provisional -> verified by verify-worker or timed-out -> manual. severe regression -> transition to quarantined + create rollback ticket.

priya: we should define what counts as "severe". propose policy: if regression_score > 0.2 AND latency_tail_ms > expected * 2 -> quarantine. else flag for QA. open to tuning.

akiko: regression_score? need a single scalar we can alert on. bench-worker should compute per-sample normalized difference and aggregate into regression_score (0..1). bench-bot: "computed regression_score for model X = 0.14"

noah: agree. verify-worker must publish a breakdown: sample_id -> metric diffs, plus overall regression_score, plus provenance (golden_manifest_v, seed, firmware/binary_profile). must include a reproducibility_token to rerun exactly.

priya: provenance is critical. also require pinning of binary_profile and a numeric runtime_seed. runtime_seed used to make RNG deterministic for sampling.

akiko: storage/economics: verify-worker will need either read access to original artifacts or local cached copies. prefer immutable URIs (signed) and a shared caching layer on bench nodes (cache keyed by fingerprint). infra-bot: cache pool proposal landing in infra-epic next sprint.

noah: interface sketch: intake -> POST /verify/request { model_uri, fingerprint, admit_ts, provisional_id, preferred_manifest_uri, binary_profile?, expected_tail_ms? } returns 202 + verify_id. verify-worker posts back results to /verify/result?verify_id=... with signed payload and optional attachments (trace link).

priya: add a rate_limit_hint and priority tag (low/normal/high) so we can shape verify traffic and avoid thundering on manifests.

akiko: for rollout: start in shadow mode (verify results ignored for state changes) for 14 days. instrument disagreement metrics: percent of provisional models where verify would have rejected/quarantined. require <0.5% discrepancy before enforcement.

noah: good. also plan a faster-path for critical security/regulatory models: they remain synchronous and stay admitted only after verify pass. admin toggle per-tenant.

priya: monitoring checklist: histogram of verify latency, per-model regression_score time series, total cost per verify-job, percent-cache-hit. alerts: regression_score spikes, queue-depth > threshold, cache miss > 30%.

akiko: UX: registry UI should show provisional badge with link to verify results. include a one-click rollback and a "re-run verify" button which resubmits with same reproducibility_token.

bench-bot: scheduled verify shadow run starting 2026-04-05 00:00 UTC for ingestion traffic. will emit periodic summary to #eng-ml.

infra-bot: infra will expose service tokens for verify-worker auth and S3 read roles for cache pool. TTL-limited.

noah: owners: I can own the verify contract doc and the provisional states registry changes. priya: owns monitoring + alerts. akiko: owns UX and manual triage flow. infra to deliver cache pool and tokens.

priya: open question: sampling strategy. do we always run full golden set (costly) or adaptive sample until confidence threshold reached? prefer adaptive: run small seed set, compute variance, continue sampling until CI width < threshold or budget exhausted. that reduces cost while keeping signal.

akiko: adaptive sounds good but needs reproducibility guarantees: sampling must use deterministic seed and produce a reproducibility_token capturing sample indexes used.

noah: agreed. include sample_indexes and seed in result payload. also require deterministic ordering of golden manifest entries.

priya: final ask: can we include a fallback policy for models that fail verify: if internal traffic > 90% usage then trigger soft-quarantine (throttle new traffic) instead of full revoke. we can configure per-tenant risk tolerance.

akiko: let's capture these in the handshake doc. sync Wed 10:30 to review draft.

noah: thanks all, short and actionable.

bench-bot: note: verify-worker shadow mode will log full results to staging-bucket for first week.

priya: thumbs up.

akiko: +1

noah: closing.
